name: phylo-tree-viewer
description: Side-by-side phylogenetic tree visualisation for the browser: a Sigma.js/graphology viewer with composable operators for expand/collapse, selection, per-leaf bar charts and tree comparison.
//: Entry points resolve to TypeScript source. That is deliberate while this is consumed only through a workspace: Vite compiles linked sources directly, so there is no build step to keep in sync. Publishing to npm requires switching these to built ESM + .d.ts — see the publishing task in the plan.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test

//peerDependencies: sigma and graphology are peers, not dependencies: the library's public API hands back its Sigma renderer and graphology Graph (TreeViewer.getRenderer/getGraph), so the consumer must share one instance. Two copies in a bundle would produce objects that are not interchangeable.
